reuse_rationale: Same visible pre-reagent state: a fresh low-volume clear colourless 1 mL water-extract aliquot in one upright tube. This pilot assumes a colourless sulphate-positive extract, not the chloride sample's chemical identity or prior acidification. Separate pilot/sample track; no amount, concentration or positive result inferred from pixels.
starting_state: Fresh 1 mL colourless sulphate-positive water-extract aliquot before HCl acidification, matching the shared visual geometry. Positive-sample identity is an explicit rendering condition requiring independent review.
scope: HCl acidification followed by barium chloride on the same sulphate-test portion. Concentrated-acid insolubility confirmation and full upstream sample preparation are omitted.

clips.name: sulphate_acidify
clips.action: Slowly acidify the existing fresh sulphate-test aliquot with dilute hydrochloric acid, keeping the tip above the rim, then stop.
clips.state_before: Fresh clear colourless sulphate-test aliquot, no reagent yet.
clips.state_after: Same aliquot after dilute HCl acidification; no barium precipitate before barium chloride.

clips.name: barium_delivery
clips.action: Deliver barium chloride to the existing acidified sulphate-test aliquot with the tip above the rim; stop delivery.
clips.state_before: The same acidified aliquot, apparatus and meniscus from the preceding final frame.
clips.state_after: White barium sulphate precipitate develops in the same sulphate-positive sample under source conditions. Preserve the existing liquid and tube; do not invent acid-insolubility testing in this clip.
